name: Reflex Arena

scale.why: assumed Quake's scale (a 56 u player, 0.03214 m/u): Reflex speeds follow Quake / CPM (320 ups), but its hull size isn't published

speed.note: the number is the wiki's; the metre conversion assumes Quake's player size

gravity.note: a community ruleset tool's dump of the Competitive (CR1) ruleset; metres at the assumed Quake scale

jump.note: plus gconst_double_jump_velocity 105 for a jump within 0.4 s of the last (#L6)

ground_accel.note: if 4000 is a fixed rate in u/s2 (it is far too big for a Quake factor): Quark-equivalent 4000 / 320 = 12.5; Reflex's ground formula isn't published

friction.note: assumed to be the Quake friction factor (the same 6 as Quake III / CPM)

air_accel.note: Reflex air with only a strafe key held (CPM-style bunny strafe): accel 60 toward 30 u/s; with forward held it is gconst_playerinair_acceleration 0.95 plus air control 150. Assumes Reflex keeps CPM's formula. Same formula as Quark's (accel x min(wish, cap)); Quark multiplies air_accel by 10, so 60 -> 6.

air_cap.note: the wish speed the air push aims at

crouchSpeed.note: 120 u/s at the assumed Quake scale; Quark: 4 m/s

wallrunMaxSpeed.note: 507 UPS at the assumed Quake scale

doubleJumpWindow.note: a jump within 0.4 s of the last one goes higher (stackable up to a triple jump)

doubleJumpBonus.note: 104 u at the assumed Quake scale

jumpHeight.note: v^2/2g from the ruleset dump; Quark: 1.22 m

doubleJumpVelocity.note: if the bonus adds to the take-off speed: 360 u/s, a 86.4 u jump (v^2/2g), 43 u higher than a single jump, not the Steam guide's 104 u, so one of the two may describe another ruleset

airAccelForward.note: the air accel with forward held (Quake III's is 1)

airControl.note: CPM-style air control, forward held (PQL's is also 150)

airDeceleration.note: the air accel against your velocity (PQL's air stop accel is also 2.5)

extras: CPM-style air control and strafe jumping
double and triple jumps (consecutive jumps within 0.4 s stack height)
notes: Reflex's physics constants became server-editable in 0.47.3 (gconst_* cvars). Their Competitive (CR1) ruleset values come from a community ruleset-comparison tool's dump (Kyt0z/reflex-ruleset-comparer): gravity 750, jump 255 (+105 double), ground speed 320, ground accel 4000, friction 6, air accel 0.95, air control 150, bunny accel 60 toward 30, air decel 2.5, crouch speed 120. They are close to CPM / PQL's. The metre conversion assumes Quake's player size and the air / ground mappings assume CPM's formulas, so those are estimates.
